PIG IRON

A downloadable game for Windows

Download NowName your own price


PIGIRON is a fast-paced horde shooter with light mech-sim elements. 


Grind your way through hundreds of escaped Bio-engineered Meat Organisms with an arsenal of horrifying flesh-metal contraptions. 

Find out who caused this disaster, and make them pay before your iron shell becomes a metal coffin

  • WASD + SPACE for movement 
  • MOUSE to aim
  • LMB to fire gun
  • RMB to fire melee 
  • scroll to swap weapons 
  • hold CTRL to FREELOOK
  • there are many buttons in the cockpit that do STUFF 
  • SHIFT to sprint 
  • DBL-TAP SHIFT to CHARGE 
  • F to deploy a FLARE 
  • V to enter REPAIR MODE 
  • C to SMONKE
